route_classes.anonymous_read_only: One bounded anonymous PagePreview, public GET, or read-only AMC matrix can establish at least part of the missing rule.
route_classes.authenticated_read_only: One bounded authenticated read-only matrix can establish at least part of the actor or admin-read rule.
route_classes.run_owned_mutation: The missing rule needs state transitions and must use a separately authorized run-owned mutation lane.
route_classes.local_candidate: The missing rule is primarily answerable on the exact local candidate and task-owned fixtures, not by another live read.
route_classes.live_browser_only: The missing rule is temporal DOM, focus, navigation, network, or interaction behavior and needs browser observation.
route_classes.missing_public_producer: No existing public state supplies the positive and negative boundary needed by the row.
route_classes.missing_architecture_domain_authority: The repository lacks the producer, model, or product authority required before evidence can become an implementation contract.
route_classes.missing_security_policy: The row needs a local security, rate-limit, fetch, or failure policy that Wikidot read-only output cannot safely authorize.
